source: Five user photographs of the Passaporte para Português glossary: pages 153, 155, 157, 159 and 124, geographical names and readable page fragments
normalization_notes: Transcribe readable entries from main pages 153, 155, 157, 159 and 124 and readable page fragments. Do not infer words from clipped or unphotographed rows.
Exclude section headings such as Nomes Geográficos and running publisher/page text from vocabulary.
Use lowercase NFC individual words; remove punctuation and trailing gender articles; retain meaningful articles/prepositions in expressions.
Expand estar com/ter sede, estar com/ter sono and estar/fazer vento into their component words; expand beijo/beijinho into two words.
The o/a annotations on turista do not imply distinct Portuguese spellings. Keep all original source labels and meanings in JSON.
Preserve lexical hyphens in segunda-feira, t-shirt, check-in and grã-bretanha. Keep autoestrada as printed without adding a hyphen.
Proper names follow the existing lowercase database policy; retain their original capitalization and full geographical names in source JSON.

Split multiword names into words: África do Sul, América Latina, Cidade do Cabo, Coreia do Sul, Estados Unidos and União Europeia. Translate components individually, not with the whole-name translation.
Retain diacritics and distinguish avó from avô. Keep European Portuguese source spellings secção, stresse, Amesterdão and Helsínquia.
Several final rows in photo 5 overlap previous photo imports; deduplicate against the live database and retain the new source occurrences.
